title: 7 Days Enchanting Greece Tour
overview:
Inclusions:
• Accommodation: 6 nights accommodation in Athens and Mykonos
• Meals: Breakfast as per the itinerary
• Transfers: Airport pick up and drop as per your flight timings and round trip transfers on a ferry from Athens to Mykonos 
• Ticket: Economy Class Normal Ferry ticket from Athens and Mykonos 
• Transport: Comfortable and hygienic vehicle for sightseeing on all days as per the itinerary
• Visa assistance: It will be provided (Charges are not included)
• Guide: Professional driver cum guide to help you explore the citiesExperiences Covered:
• Panoramic city tour of Athens city centre
• Photo Stop at the Panathinaikon Stadium
• Guided tour of Acropolis (Propylae the gateway, Temple of Athena Nike, Parthenon, Erechtheion with its Porch of Maidens)
• Pass the atmospheric Old Port with the signature ‘Kato Milli’ windmills
• Stroll through Chora’s maze-like streets flanked by cubist whitewashed buildings adorned in colorful blooms
• Visit to traditional Ano Mera village
• Explore Panagia Tourliani - the prettiest monastery in MykonosNot to Miss in Greece:
• Partying till dawn at Paradise Beach Night Club in Mykonos
• Discovering the quaint village of Pyrgos in Mykonos & click instagram worthy pictures
• Sunbathing in the blue sun loungers at Psarou Beach MykonosNote: Package customization available on request. Drop an inquiry to know more.Destination info:
• Official Name: Hellenic Republic
• Currency: Euro
• Capital: Athens
• Time Zone: GMT+3
• Plug Type: C & FHow to Reach:There are numerous India to Athens flights that are operating frequently from the major cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Chennai, and more. The fastest Mumbai to Athens flight is flown by Turkish Airlines, taking the duration of 10 hours. However, most Mumbai to Athens or Delhi to Athens flights make a stopover at various European cities like Istanbul, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Dubai, or Zurich or Budapest in Europe. Depending on the number of stops, a flight can take up to 32 hours to reach Athens.

days.title: Welcome to Greece! Arrival in Athens
prose: Get ready to start an adventure that you will cherish for eternity; the city of ancient ruins anticipates your arrival
Meet your driver at the Athens Airport or the Port of Piraeus and enjoy a panoramic drive you transfer to your hotel to check-in
Free time at your leisure, according to your arrival time
Overnight stay in Athens

days.title: Explore Athens | City Tour | Touring Acropolis, visiting Parthenon & the Temple of Athena etc
prose: Start your exciting morning with a tasty breakfast at Hotel

Morning or afternoon half day sightseeing tour of Athens including the Acropolis, Constitution Square, Memorial of the Unknown Soldier, National Library, Temple of Zeus, the Olympic Stadium and Parliament House
Overnight Stay at Hotels in Athens

days.title: Discover Stunning Mykonos | Proceed from Athens to Mykonos (via ferry)
prose: After breakfast transfer to the port for your ferry to Mykonos
Upon arrival at the port of the island of Mykonos, you will be assisted and transferred to your hotel
There are plenty of cafes and restaurants here, so grab a table towards the end of the day to enjoy an amazing sunset
Look out for the Mykonos pelicans - an added attraction!
Overnight stay in Hotels at Mykonos

days.title: Witness the surreal beauty of Mykonos | Half Day City & Island Tour
prose: After breakfast discovers the highlights of Mykonos on a comfortable city walk to the unique sites
After that on a bus tour that takes you all over the island to the beautiful bays and beaches as well as to the traditional village of Ano Mera
Packed with a lot of information about the culture, history, and places to go! You are going to Love it
Overnight stay at hotels in Mykonos

days.title: Discover the highlights of Mykonos | Tour of Delos (Optional)
prose: Enjoy your stay in the island of Aeolos (God of the Wind), Mykonos. Breakfast is served at the hotel. The day is yours to enjoy this island of paradise with many optional tours to choose from

Take the opportunity to swim into the crystal blue Mykonian sea and take a sip of a mouthwatering cocktail by its golden beaches. Take a walk around its many well preserved windmills and hundreds of little white houses and do not miss visiting the historical ancient site of Delos
Overnight in Mykonos.Optional Tours (available at additional cost):- Tour of Delos

days.title: Head back to Athens from Mykonos (via Ferry)
prose: After breakfast, you will be transferred to the port for your ferry to Athens
Upon arrival transfer to your hotel. Balance of the day at leisure
Visit the picturesque Pláka neighborhood a tourist hot spot. The main attraction of this historic area is its charming village ambiance
Narrow pedestrian streets and the cheerful little squares of the Pláka quarter are lined with lovely bougainvillea-trimmed pastel-painted houses, restaurants, and shops
Overnight stay in Athens

days.title: Departure day
prose: Wake up with a mouth-watering breakfast and pack your bags full of unforgettable memories
You will be picked up from your hotel in order to be transferred to Athens airport for your final departure flight
Board the flight and treasure the moments you have spent in this beautiful country

gallery.caption: Don't harbor any resent for me- Taking some Me-konos time.
Every passport stamp comes with a story.
This was 100% worth the long flight.
